    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    print("Doc:", doc.name)
    products = doc.products
    for p in range(products.count):
        prod = products.item(p)
        print("Product:", prod.productType)
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    if cam:
        print("Setups:")
        for s in cam.setups:
            print("  ", s.name, "opCount=", s.operations.count)
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    if design:
        root = design.rootComponent
        print("Bodies:", root.bRepBodies.count)
        for b in root.bRepBodies:
            bb = b.boundingBox
            print("  Body:", b.name)
            print("   min", [round(v*10,3) for v in bb.minPoint.asArray()])
            print("   max", [round(v*10,3) for v in bb.maxPoint.asArray()])

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    products = doc.products
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    body = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    print("Faces:", body.faces.count)
    # Group faces by orientation
    for i, f in enumerate(body.faces):
        geo = f.geometry
        gtype = type(geo).__name__
        bb = f.boundingBox
        info = ""
        if gtype == 'Plane':
            n = geo.normal
            info = "normal=%s" % [round(v,2) for v in n.asArray()]
        elif gtype == 'Cylinder':
            info = "R=%.3f axis=%s" % (geo.radius*10, [round(v,2) for v in geo.axis.asArray()])
        print(i, gtype, info,
              "min", [round(v*10,2) for v in bb.minPoint.asArray()],
              "max", [round(v*10,2) for v in bb.maxPoint.asArray()],
              "area=%.1f" % (f.area*100))

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    products = doc.products
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    setup = cam.setups.item(0)
    print("Setup:", setup.name)
    print("operationType:", setup.operationType)
    # WCS
    p = setup.parameters
    for pr in p:
        try:
            print("  param:", pr.name, "=", pr.expression if hasattr(pr,'expression') else '')
        except:
            pass
    # models
    print("Models:", setup.models.count if hasattr(setup,'models') else 'na')

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    camMgr = adsk.cam.CAMManager.get()
    libMgr = camMgr.libraryManager
    toolLibs = libMgr.toolLibraries
    url = adsk.core.URL.create("toollibraryroot://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)")
    lib = toolLibs.toolLibraryAtURL(url)
    print("Tool count:", lib.count)
    for i in range(lib.count):
        t = lib.item(i)
        p = t.parameters
        def g(n):
            try: return p.itemByName(n).value.value
            except: return None
        tp = t.parameters.itemByName('tool_type').value.value if t.parameters.itemByName('tool_type') else '?'
        dia = g('tool_diameter')
        num = g('tool_number')
        desc = g('tool_description') or ''
        flutes = g('tool_numberOfFlutes')
        print(i, "#%s"%num, tp, "d=%s"%(round(dia,3) if dia else dia), "fl=%s"%flutes, desc)

    products = adsk.core.Application.get().activeDocument.products
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    body = design.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    # collect cylinder faces grouped by (radius, axis-dir)
    from collections import defaultdict
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for i,f in enumerate(body.faces):
        g=f.geometry
        if type(g).__name__=='Cylinder':
            r=round(g.radius*10,2)
            ax=tuple(round(a) for a in g.axis.asArray())
            bb=f.boundingBox
            cx=round((bb.minPoint.x+bb.maxPoint.x)/2*10,1)
            cy=round((bb.minPoint.y+bb.maxPoint.y)/2*10,1)
            cz=round((bb.minPoint.z+bb.maxPoint.z)/2*10,1)
            groups[(r,ax)].append((i,cx,cy,cz))
    for k in sorted(groups):
        r,ax=k
        print("R=%.2f (d=%.2f) axis=%s  count=%d"%(r,r*2,ax,len(groups[k])))
        for it in groups[k][:8]:
            print("     face%d  center(x,y,z)=(%s,%s,%s)"%it)
